title: Migrate Kanbus docs site (publish) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated (Kanbus PR #527 merged: papyrus-newsroom 5.1.0, anthus-markus 0.13, site-url). NOT published: GitHub Pages is not enabled for AnthusAI/Kanbus (Pages API 404) and the deploy job is gated on DOCS_DEPLOY. To publish: set Pages source to GitHub Actions and DOCS_DEPLOY=true.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified live 2026-10-21: https://anthusai.github.io/Kanbus/ serves 200 text/html, /llms.txt 200 text/plain, /index.md 200 text/markdown, /sitemap.xml 200 application/xml. GitHub Pages is enabled (build_type workflow) and DOCS_DEPLOY=true is set; the Docs workflow last succeeded on main. The earlier blocker in the comment above is gone.
